### MPT Completes the Sale of Two Hospitals for $371 Million in Cash


September 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/146646187/files/doc_news/MPT-Completes-the-Sale-of-Two-Hospitals-for-371-Million-in-Cash-2026.pdf)


*Gain of Approximately $130 Million Over Gross Book Value*


*Transaction Brings Total Third Quarter Asset Sale Proceeds to Approximately $680 Million*


BIRMINGHAM, Ala.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Medical Properties Trust, Inc. (the “Company” or “MPT”) (NYSE: MPT) today announced the sale of the real estate of Idaho Falls Community Hospital and Mountain View Hospital to affiliates of Intermountain Health, an investment grade not-for-profit health system, for $413 million (the “Transaction”), a 6.9% capitalization rate.


The Transaction provides $371 million in cash proceeds to the Company with the remaining $42 million distributed to certain minority real estate owners. The gross investment in the properties approximated $240 million.


The Transaction, along with the previously disclosed Infracore Initial Public Offering and sale of the Company’s interest in five hospitals in Utah, aggregates approximately $680 million in cash proceeds to the Company during the third quarter. Each of these transaction values represent significant increases above the Company’s initial investment amounts and further demonstrate the strength of MPT’s underwriting and the value embedded in its portfolio.


The Company expects to use a majority of the sale proceeds to reduce debt.


**About Medical Properties Trust, Inc.**


Medical Properties Trust, Inc. is a self-advised real estate investment trust formed in 2003 to acquire and develop net-leased hospital facilities. From its inception in Birmingham, Alabama, the Company has grown to become one of the world’s largest owners of hospital real estate with 373 facilities and approximately 38,000 licensed beds in nine countries and across three continents as of June 30, 2026. MPT’s financing model facilitates acquisitions and recapitalizations, and allows operators of hospitals to unlock the value of their real estate assets to fund facility improvements, technology upgrades and other investments in operations. For more information, please visit the Company’s website at **[www.mpt.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mpt.com&esheet=54604981&newsitemid=20260915866488&lan=en-US&anchor=www.mpt.com&index=1&md5=f5c02784c6ad38c93bd5dac4497210dc)** .
